posts.title: Admitting Inadequacies of Self
posts.description: ‘Envy’ is listed as one of the seven deadly sins. To be envious (or jealous) 1 is to be human, and it’s definitely normal for that green-eyed monster to pay us a visit sometimes. But as time goes on, I observe how people tend to project those ugly feelings outward instead of inward.
